description: One line of quality.jsonl — per-page diagnostic signals, not calibrated accuracy. Schema version 0.1.

confidence.description: Adapter-reported page confidence, 0–1. Evidence, not calibrated probability. Null when the engine reports none.

confidence_detail.description: Engine-native confidence evidence, adapter-defined shape. pdf_ocr reports Tesseract per-word statistics: scale, word_count, mean, min, below_60_count, below_60_ratio.

embedded_text_comparison.description: Comparison against the PDF's embedded text layer. Null when source is not a PDF or adapter already reports embedded_text capability.

grade.description: Deterministic evidence summary, not calibrated accuracy. Worst of the signal and schema axes. Only comparable within one adapter.

grade_basis.description: signals_only: graded on text signals alone (no alignment). schema_aware: schema column/check evidence contributed. A signals-only A is weaker evidence than a schema-aware A.

confidence_band.description: Null when the adapter reports no confidence — the signals grade then rests on warnings alone.

output_integrity.description: Conservative evidence of leaked chat-template markers and rerun output inflation. Added in PageLedger 0.1.4; optional for compatibility with older quality lines.

digit_count.description: Decimal digits in the output. With letter_count it identifies text layers that kept a table's digits and lost its words. Optional for compatibility with older quality lines.

foreign_script_count.description: Letters and marks from scripts other than Latin, Cyrillic or Greek, letterlike symbols and mathematical alphanumerics excepted. Optional for compatibility with older quality lines.

largest_identical_line_count.description: How often the most repeated non-empty line occurs, ignoring dot leaders and rules. Optional for compatibility with older quality lines.

latin_letter_ratio.description: Share of Unicode letters whose names identify the Latin script. Added as a conservative joined-text guard; optional for compatibility with older quality lines.

letter_count.description: Unicode letters in the output. Optional for compatibility with older quality lines.

longest_letter_run.description: Longest run of one letter repeated, such as a model stuck on one character; 0 when no letter repeats. Optional for compatibility with older quality lines.

longest_repeated_tail_length.description: Length in characters of the longest ending made of one unit of up to 200 characters repeated at least 20 times. Optional for compatibility with older quality lines.

max_token_length.description: Maximum Unicode letter-plus-mark token length. Added as joined-text evidence; optional for compatibility with older quality lines.

mean_token_length.description: Mean Unicode letter-plus-mark token length. Null when the page has none. The <3 boundary is a fragment-noise heuristic, not a cross-language quality score.

mixed_script_token_ratio.description: Share of letter tokens that mix Latin, Cyrillic or Greek letters, as look-alike substitutions do. Optional for compatibility with older quality lines.

prereform_letter_count.description: Occurrences of Cyrillic letters abolished by the 1918 Russian orthographic reform (ѣ, ѳ, ѵ). Modern Ukrainian/Belarusian і is deliberately not counted.

private_use_count.description: Private Use Area code points, except one that opens a line before a space (a bullet or icon glyph). Optional for compatibility with older quality lines.

short_token_ratio.description: Share of Unicode letter-plus-mark tokens with 1-2 code points. Null when the page has none.

terminal_hard_sign_count.description: Word-final hard signs (ъ) — mandatory in pre-1918 Russian orthography, absent from modern text. Survives OCR even when abolished letters do not.

whitespace_character_ratio.description: Share of output characters for which str.isspace() is true. Added as joined-text evidence; optional for compatibility with older quality lines.

warnings.description: Adapter-native warnings plus PageLedger-derived quality warnings such as empty_text, short_text, replacement_characters, control_characters, suspicious_symbol_density, fragmented_text, joined_text, suspicious_embedded_text_delta, multi_column_rows, historical_orthography, low_confidence, instruction_echo, output_inflation, digits_only_text, mixed_script_tokens, private_use_characters, foreign_script_characters, repeated_page_text, repetition_loop, script_mismatch, and historical_letters_lost.

word_count.description: Count of Unicode letter tokens; combining marks remain attached to their base-letter token.

title: PageLedger Quality Line (JSONL)
